items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 134:1
items.html: (To the question) The souls of males are drawn only from MA, either from MA of MA or from MA of BON. And the females are drawn only from BON, either from BON of MA or from BON of BON. And it is always related to the aspect of its male: if the male is from the aspect of MA of MA, the Nukva will be BON of MA; and if the male is from MA of BON, the Nukva will be from BON of BON. (Item 158).
